provenance.selection: Exact 100 WR-2 eligible facts; roles and corpora preserved. All frozen rows must agree on each fact metadata record; crosschecked against FactSpec.

policy.canonical_candidates: Use exact full frozen-bank candidate strings; keep native shortened J-lens forms separately for the unchanged control.
policy.one_sided: Only the positive candidate enters the primary score. Negative filler surfaces are recorded for completeness and must not enter the primary score.
policy.surface_expansion: For each explicit lexical form: original, lower, title, upper; deduplicate identical strings; store bare and exactly one leading-space version of each.
policy.protected_case_rationale: Preserve acronym, option-letter, programming-language-letter and party-name identity in lower/title renderings; all-uppercase presentation is retained.
policy.synonyms: At most two prewritten synonyms per active candidate, justified in the question context. No semantic synonyms for proper names other than the unambiguous full country-name alternative; no title-based or approximate identity aliases.
policy.number_inflection: Only explicit countable class labels. No invented plural entity names, no pluralisation of adjective predicates or mass nouns, no expansion of one-sided negation/fillers.
policy.literal_phrase: For bigram-presence facts65–85, no number inflection or synonym: such changes would alter the registered literal phrase. Case and leading-space representations remain available.
policy.averaging: Each deduplicated stored surface receives equal weight. No score-dependent max, selection, reweighting or post-scoring edits.
policy.limitations: Some clear within-context synonyms differ in specificity or connotation; this is a fixed conservative vocabulary operationalisation, not exhaustive lexical coverage. Number-inflected labels name the same category, not a grammatical sentence about the single input.
policy.outcome_blinding: No activation, matrix, probe, native outcome, item label, score, or metric informed lexical additions. No tokenizer was loaded in manifest generation.
